Task Name: R1.1 — Sequence CRUD + step builder API
Description: Full CRUD for sequences and sequence_steps: create/update/delete a sequence, add/reorder/remove steps (email/linkedin/wait/task), set delayDays, subject, bodyTemplate. AC: CRUD endpoints workspace-scoped; reorder keeps step order unique and contiguous; body templates support validated merge tokens; status lifecycle draft to active to paused to archived.

AC: enroll creates per-step schedule; scheduler executes due steps in business-hours window; reply/bounce/meeting branching forks or stops cadence; idempotent and retryable; duplicate enroll rejected.

UI to build cadences (drag-reorder steps), enroll lists/prospects, and view per-sequence analytics. AC: visual step builder with delay and channel; enroll from list or prospect detail with live status; per-step funnel metrics displayed.

Track thread state (new to replied to bounced to meeting_booked to closed) and surface unread counts per workspace. AC: state transitions recorded with timestamps; unread badge counts correct; optional AI-assisted sentiment/intent tag on reply.

Thread list and conversation view; reply inline; shows linked prospect, sequence, and score context. AC: GET /inbox/threads returns real threads with pagination and filters; reply sends through the thread inbox; prospect/sequence context panel beside conversation.

Connect Google/Microsoft mailboxes via OAuth and generic SMTP/IMAP; store encrypted tokens; per-inbox daily send caps. AC: GET /inboxes lists connected inboxes with health and cap usage; tokens encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM); test-send verifies inbox before activation.
Rotate sends across healthy inboxes, throttle per inbox/day, back off on bounce spikes. AC: round-robin/weighted rotation respects caps; auto-pause an inbox when bounce/spam rate exceeds threshold.

Sending-domain registration, SPF/DKIM/DMARC checks, gradual warmup ramp, bounce/spam/blacklist monitoring. AC: GET /domains returns DNS-record health; warmup ramps daily volume on a schedule; blacklist/spam alerts per domain.

UI to connect inboxes, view domain DNS health, and monitor warmup and bounce metrics. AC: connect-inbox flow with per-inbox health cards; domain DNS checklist with copy-paste records; warmup and bounce/spam charts.

Add review state to ai_drafts (pending to approved to rejected to edited); endpoints to approve/reject/edit before a draft is used in a sequence step. AC: GET /ai/drafts supports status filter and pagination; approve/reject/edit audit-logged; only approved drafts are sendable.

Reviewer screen: queued drafts with prospect context, inline edit, approve/reject, bulk approve. AC: queue lists pending drafts with prospect and score context; inline edit and bulk actions; approved drafts flow into sequence enrollment.

Make /v1/score LLM-first with heuristic fallback; return structured reasoning per dimension. AC: LLM path default when OPENAI_API_KEY set with heuristic fallback on error/timeout; source=llm with per-dimension explanation; latency/cost budget respected via input caching.

Replace hardcoded /v1/classify with a real intent model over signals, firmographics, job posts; typed intent with rationale and HITL gating. AC: /v1/classify returns model-derived intent and confidence; feeds intentScore and outreach readiness; low-confidence flagged for review.

Promote LLM pain-points from personalize-only to a stored, typed field surfaced on prospect detail. AC: pain points constrained to a typed enum and stored on prospect/activation; shown on prospect detail with source rationale.
